pairs.subject: docs-sync
pairs.evidence: src/app/api/gdd-compliance/route.ts:33 resolve-gap stores a dismissal of a design-doc-vs-code gap keyed only by a stable gap id (gap-<module>-<kind>-<item>), without the evidence revision it dismissed, so every later audit re-applies it even after the code or the GDD moves; a disputed design claim then reads as settled, which is the dismiss-transition failure earned-verification-state names.

techniques.evidence: src/app/api/gdd-compliance/route.ts:33 The resolution stores resolved_at and a note but no evidence binding. The lib's runComplianceAudit re-marks the gap resolved by id on every re-audit, so there is no reaffirm-against-moved-evidence path.

pairs.registryProposal: earned-verification-state could say outright that a durable 'resolve/dismiss' on a design-doc-vs-code gap must record the evidence revision it dismissed, or else lapse when that evidence changes. In-product doc-compliance tools hit this pattern, not only rot scanners.

pairs.subject: docs-sync
pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/evaluator/GameDesignDocView/index.tsx:39 GameDesignDocView treats an unchanged checklist as proof the synthesized GDD is current and renders no generatedAt. The document's sections come from feature_matrix, level docs, eval findings and builds (gdd-synthesizer.ts:156,189), so after a feature review the view shows a stale GDD as current with no age on screen.

techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/evaluator/GameDesignDocView/index.tsx:39 The GDD view's freshness is assumed from a partial input key and its age is not shown. The sibling GDDComplianceView does conform (constants.ts:57 keeps the evidence age separate from the audit stamp and never rounds unknown up to fresh).

src/components/modules/evaluator/GDDComplianceView/constants.ts:116 An unmeasured design-vs-code gap is its own 'unmeasured' state with no lean, not folded into compliant. This is unverifiable-is-not-clean.
src/components/modules/evaluator/GDDComplianceView/EvidenceStrip.tsx:10 The score is printed as a fraction of what was checked. index.tsx:126 says 'unmeasured — no evidence' when nothing was checked.

src/components/modules/evaluator/GDDComplianceView/MappingStrip.tsx:22 Reports the coverage of the checklist→feature map (unmapped, guessed by label substring, dangling mappings at :23), not just its membership. It is a report, not a gate.

pairs.subject: docs-sync
pairs.evidence: src/hooks/useGameDesignDoc.ts:113 The freshness gate keys the cached GDD on project and checklist hash only, while synthesizeGDD also reads feature_matrix, level_design_docs, audio scenes, eval findings and builds. The hook therefore adopts a document as 'still-fresh' after inputs it never digested have changed, and only a forced refresh rechecks.

techniques.evidence: src/hooks/useGameDesignDoc.ts:113 A freshness claim is granted without checking most of the evidence the document is derived from (gdd-synthesizer.ts:156 featureSummary, :189 evalFindings). Cache key at :135.
src/hooks/useDesignDocument.ts:71 Level design docs with no code link are counted as unlinked, separate from synced. The uncheckable are not folded into clean.
